data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'guideiros' meaning 'guide' or 'leader'. In the New Testament, the name Guyon is given to a centurion who, in his faith, healed a servant. This name embodies the qualities of a strong and steadfast leader. The name Guyer carries the meaning “Guide, leader” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Guyer usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Guyer is therefore a powerful symbol of spiritual growth, strength, and unwavering faith.
